Story file and requirements: - Story exists: docs/stories/010.0-DEV-DEEP-VALIDATION.story.md - Defines deep-validation requirements: REQ-DEEP-PARSE, REQ-DEEP-MATCH, REQ-DEEP-FORMAT, REQ-DEEP-SECTION, REQ-DEEP-CACHE, REQ-DEEP-ERROR.
Core implementation (deep requirement validation): - Rule file: src/rules/valid-req-reference.ts - File header explicitly ties to this story: - @story docs/stories/010.0-DEV-DEEP-VALIDATION.story.md - @req REQ-DEEP-PARSE, REQ-DEEP-MATCH, REQ-DEEP-CACHE, REQ-DEEP-PATH - Deep parsing and matching: - extractStoryPath(comment): parses @story lines from JSDoc/comments (REQ-DEEP-PARSE). - loadAndCacheRequirements({ resolvedStoryPath, reqCache }): - Reads the story file via fs.readFileSync. - Uses regex /REQ-[A-Z0-9-]+/g to collect all requirement IDs anywhere in the markdown. - Caches the Set of IDs per resolvedStoryPath (REQ-DEEP-PARSE, REQ-DEEP-CACHE). - extractReqIdFromLine(line): returns the requirement token from a '@req REQ-XXX...' line (REQ-DEEP-PARSE). - checkRequirementExists({ comment, context, reqId, storyPath, reqSet }): - If !reqSet.has(reqId), reports context.report({ messageId: 'reqMissing', data: { reqId, storyPath } }) (REQ-DEEP-MATCH). - validateReqLine and higher-level helpers (handleAnnotationLine, processCommentLines, handleComment, processAllComments) coordinate reading comments, tracking current storyPath, and validating each @req line (REQ-DEEP-PARSE, REQ-DEEP-MATCH, REQ-DEEP-CACHE). - Path validation and project integration (REQ-DEEP-PATH, integration with 006.0 file validation): - validateAndResolveStoryPath({ comment, context, storyPath, cwd }): - Rejects path traversal and absolute paths (storyPath.includes('..') or path.isAbsolute) and reports messageId 'invalidPath'. - Resolves to absolute path with path.resolve(cwd, storyPath). - Enforces project boundary by checking resolvedStoryPath.startsWith(cwd + path.sep) or equals cwd, otherwise reports 'invalidPath'. - resolveStoryAndRequirements combines path validation with requirement loading and caching. - Caching behavior (REQ-DEEP-CACHE): - loadAndCacheRequirements only reads and parses each story file once per lint run; results are stored in a Map keyed by resolvedStoryPath. - programListener(context) creates a single reqCache Map and passes it into processAllComments, so the cache is reused across all comments in a file. - Robust error handling (Error Handling criterion): - loadAndCacheRequirements wraps fs.readFileSync in try/catch and on error caches an empty Set instead of throwing, preventing lint crashes on unreadable/malformed files. - validateAndResolveStoryPath reports 'invalidPath' instead of throwing for unsafe paths.
Requirement format and story structure handling: - Story 010.0 lists REQ-DEEP-* IDs in a markdown list; the regex /REQ-[A-Z0-9-]+/g used in loadAndCacheRequirements matches these regardless of bolding or section. - Fixtures demonstrate multiple formats/structures: - tests/fixtures/story_bullet.md: bullet-list requirements (e.g., '- REQ-BULLET-LIST - description'). - tests/fixtures/story_multi_a.md and story_multi_b.md: list items with IDs REQ-SHARED-ID, REQ-ONLY-A, REQ-ONLY-B for multi-story and shared-ID scenarios. - Because IDs are extracted purely by regex over the full file content, the implementation inherently supports: - Inline IDs, bullet lists, numbered lists, bolded IDs. - Requirements located in any section (Requirements, Acceptance Criteria, etc.).
Error messages and user experience (REQ-DEEP-ERROR, dependency on 007.0): - src/rules/valid-req-reference.ts defines clear diagnostics: - messages.reqMissing: - Annotated with 010.0 and 007.0 error-reporting requirements. - Template: "Requirement '{{reqId}}' not found in '{{storyPath}}'" (includes both ID and story path). - messages.invalidPath: - Template: "Invalid story path '{{storyPath}}'". - These messages are exercised in tests: - tests/rules/valid-req-reference.test.ts invalid cases verify messageId and data, e.g.: - Missing requirement: reqMissing with data { reqId: 'REQ-NON-EXISTENT', storyPath: 'docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md' }. - Bad paths: invalidPath with specific storyPath values for traversal and absolute paths.

([Documentation](docs/rules/valid-req-reference.md))'.
Documentation of behavior and supported formats: - docs/rules/valid-req-reference.md: - Annotated with @story docs/stories/010.0-DEV-DEEP-VALIDATION.story.md and REQ-DEEP-PARSE, REQ-DEEP-MATCH, REQ-DEEP-PATH. - Describes rule behavior: - Verifies each referenced story file exists and is within project directory. - Parses each story file to extract requirement IDs. - Ensures each @req/@implements requirement ID matches an identifier in that story file. - Reports invalidPath for unsafe paths and reqMissing for missing requirements. - Explains scoping of IDs per story file. - Provides concrete examples of correct/incorrect usage for @req and @implements, including path traversal and absolute path cases.

traceability.notes: The story 010.0-DEV-DEEP-VALIDATION is fully implemented. A dedicated ESLint rule (valid-req-reference) parses @story/@req and @implements annotations, validates and resolves story paths with security and project-boundary checks, reads the corresponding story files, extracts requirement IDs in a format- and section-agnostic way, caches results per story file, and verifies that all referenced IDs actually exist. Missing requirements and invalid paths produce clear error messages that include both the requirement ID and the story path. Tests specifically tied to this story cover normal story files, bullet-list formats, multi-story and shared-ID scenarios, and path error conditions. The rule is integrated into the plugin’s dynamic rule loading and configuration, and its behavior is documented with concrete examples. All acceptance criteria (core functionality, quality/format handling, integration with existing validation, user experience, error handling, and documentation) are satisfied based on the current code, tests, and docs.
